There's actually a psychological concept called "enclothed cognition" that suggests the clothes we wear can influence our mental state and behavior. It might also be about the ritual of dressing up—the act of putting on formalwear can serve as a mental cue that it's time to perform, lead, or take on a challenge. Plus, how others perceive and respond to you in formal attire can reinforce that sense of self-assurance.
